detail.title: Advancing Predictive Processing Research in Music Cognition
detail.summary: Continued investigation into the intersection of predictive coding, music cognition, and reward systems, focusing on the emotional dimensions of musical tension and resolution to refine the understanding of how predictive processing models drive aesthetic pleasure.
